sql.gapClaims:
SELECT c.id, c.org_id AS "orgId", o.dept AS department,
                     c.group_name AS "groupName", c.published_at,
                     c.evidence_url AS "evidenceUrl", c.source
                FROM leak_claim c
                JOIN org o ON o.id = c.org_id
               WHERE c.na
                 AND o.dept = ANY($1::text[])
                 AND c.org_id IS NOT NULL
                 AND c.evidence_url ILIKE 'https://%'
                 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM event e WHERE e.dedup_key = $2 || c.id)
               ORDER BY c.id
sql.departments:
SELECT o.dept AS department, count(*)::int AS events
                  FROM event e
                  JOIN org o ON o.id = e.org_id
                 WHERE o.dept = ANY($1::text[])
                 GROUP BY o.dept
sql.sourceByGroup: SELECT id FROM source WHERE family = 'ransomware' AND id = $1 LIMIT 1
sql.sourceFallback: SELECT id FROM source WHERE family = 'ransomware' ORDER BY id LIMIT 1
